fix_subject: C API V1: mark ext scalar functions as fallible
pr_title: In 2.0 scalar functions must call `SetFallible()` to be able to report

labels.summary: Scalar functions registered through the C API V1 entry point were not marked fallible, so execution errors they raised were reported as "INTERNAL Error: ... not marked as fallible"; the fix marks all such functions fallible by default.
